WDS Fight Night 14 summary

WDS Fight Night 14 took place on 9 November 2025 at Fit & Fight Club, Navi Mumbai, Navi Mumbai. The card had 19 bouts (5 professional and 14 amateur). 8 of the 19 decided bouts ended inside the distance by knockout, TKO or submission. In the main event, Ashok Bagde beat Karan Singh by submission in round 1.
